ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.

3. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

4. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.

5. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.

6. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

8. When learning Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

9. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

10. When learning Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

12. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
